_comment: Hand-built query -> relevant-chunk pairs for retrieval quality checks. chunk_id values are content-hash ids (sha256 of the chunk's cleaned text) from a specific loaded sample of the Electronics review dataset. If the chunks table is truncated and repopulated from a different sample, these ids will no longer exist and this file must be regenerated by hand-picking new chunks from whatever is currently loaded.

pairs.query: indoor camera for watching my dog while I'm away
pairs.chunk_text: This indoor camera works good. I can see what the puppy is doing when I leave the room. It works good at night with the lights off. When the heat comes on I can see the dust flying around the room. But you can not point it at the window to see what is happening outside. The camera reflects off the window and you can’t see anything.

pairs.query: screen protector for an iPad Pro that's easy to install
pairs.chunk_text: I found this screen protector to be quite easy to place on my new 11" I-Pad Pro. I've used other screen protectors on my other electronics and they were harder to put on. This screen protector is quite easy. I recommend it highly.

pairs.query: small case to store hearing aids and spare batteries
pairs.chunk_text: I got this to hold my hearing aids, and they fit perfectly with room for extra batteries.

pairs.query: protective Kindle cover that keeps the device secure if you drop it
pairs.chunk_text: This is beautiful and the best cover I have bought for my new Kindle. It straps inside so if you drop it, the Kindle is NOT coming out of the case. Only down side is that it’s heavier than other covers because it is so sturdy. It’s like the Otter of Kindle Covers

pairs.query: headset microphone that filters background noise well on work calls
pairs.chunk_text: This sounds great and does a great job of filtering out backgroound noises.. My co-workers say I sound much better and clearer. So happy with this purchase!

pairs.query: glasses or lenses that arrived broken or damaged in shipping
pairs.chunk_text: These didn’t work. Idk if they were damaged in shipping or what, but the lenses were loose or something. I could see half a lens with its edge in the frame and the rest was missing. It looked like it came loose or was broken.

pairs.query: cable management clips to keep cords off the floor along a baseboard
pairs.chunk_text: Purchased these to tame a few cords... I placed them directly on my baseboard - which would be fine, but my old house has a rounded baseboard... flat have worked better - but even still it's works. I put a satellite cable and an old school land line phone line in it with room to spare. The sticky back seems to hold even on the slightly rolled surface and is keeping the cords off the floor so the robo vac doesn't become entangled. It takes a second or two to figure out the opening, but once that's figured out - it's a breeze to set, press and go. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review is helpful to you.

pairs.query: smart TV review praising its features but not the sound quality
pairs.chunk_text: Great TV. This is my first smart TV, and I haven’t even used many smart features, but the features I’ve used are terrific. I haven’t found any modern TV with decent sound quality.
